verdict.left_looks: A sandstone desert market with a tiered, crenellated parapet and a domed, stepped central roof. A band of terracotta alternates with sand-colored walls. Dark wooden crate blocks run along the facade as a frieze. Orange and white striped awnings project over the front. Stall details sit under the awnings: barrels, hanging cloth and produce, with a doorway gap, leafy shrubs at the corners, and a small rooftop terrace opening. The massing varies, with a raised dome and tower.
verdict.right_looks: A rectangular sandstone box with a plain terracotta wall panel and chiseled sandstone corner pillars and plinth. The top has an alternating parapet of gray blocks and sand. The front has a central entrance with a pillar and a red carpet, and a few rectangular window cut-outs. There are small red and pink awning strips at the top. The wall is mostly flat, uniform terracotta. The back looks hollow, with see-through window openings.
verdict.why: Left has varied massing, a dome, striped awnings, stall props and layered banding that read as a lively market. Right is a flat terracotta box with sparse openings and little detail.
